name: print-social-purple-money-transfer-ad-with-hand-and-orbit-flags
title: Lilac money-transfer ad with a hand holding a phone under arcs linking country flags, and store badges
whatItIs: A lilac portrait ad with a logo, headline 'Send Money Beyond Borders.' with 'Borders' in violet, a hand with teal nails holding a phone below thin orbit arcs connecting five country flags, a big violet curve at the bottom and App Store and Google Play badges plus a URL pill.
whatItMeans: Friendly and global; the orbit arcs show money travelling.
techniques: Link flags with thin orbit arcs.
Use a large curve as a base.

vocabulary.definition: A thin curved line linking nodes.
A small flag icon on an arc.
A big curve anchoring the bottom.
